claims.text: Pillar root dominates 543,325 declarations (thm 466,973; def 74,169; inductive 2,181; opaque 2); 191,640 are compiler auxiliaries; 250,280 live in folder Development.AbelianVarietyTheory and 263,551 are declared in namespace GlobalTheory.
The pillar is one implication through a 46-field record: nonempty_hyps_definite_side_of_closed_bound (451,610) produces Nonempty HypsAlt; every_character_of_green_v_win (23,523) consumes it.
ZeroFreeAll unfolds to: every primitive Dirichlet L-function is nonvanishing for Re s > 1/2; EveryCharacter follows by the standard primitive/imprimitive reduction.

Automorphic forms and lifts are not defined objects at assembly level: ColumnChain has abstract class types, value types and step maps; PeriodMap has abstract types. Number fields, Hermitian spaces and lattices in D7 are Mathlib objects.

About 25 HypsAlt fields are Closed-statements, vacuous unless arbitrarily large families exist. The only existence field is hEx; DesignChoices has the quantifier order for-all-K exists-family; its guards MinkDiv and HostExW are discharged on the live path by minkowski_bound_rat and supplyChi.
The existence proof behind hEx (large_unramified_exponent_bundles_exist_alt, 37,318 declarations) was read at signature level only.

The theta contracts ThetaIntegralsAgree and LocalMatching are stated over Mathlib number fields and adeles and are proved in-project outside the pillar; inside the producer they are used at three lemma applications.
Hypothesis field siegelEisensteinSimplePole has type UnusedSlot72, an abbreviation for True.
Ghost hypothesis: the closed bound-at-two-three row passed by the root is used downstream only for its eps1 and threshold; the bound is re-derived from Hypotheses₂.
On the live path the two bare proposition slots of TopShapeAlt are True, and the option slots anyGeometry and SExt.none are trivial.

The first construction stage of data has an empty local index type (Loc := Empty) and several setters require IsEmpty Loc; withLoc installs local data later. Non-emptiness of Loc in the final families was not verified.
Hyps, DRS, plugAll and plugWin occur in source but not in kernel.db; the live counterparts are HypsAlt and DefiniteSideCondition.
Ranks encodes a chain of m steps with step-j rank k + j(t+1); LinkN is quantified over the m lifts.

remark.pdf describes iterated theta lifts between totally definite unitary groups with chain length m, Chowla–Selberg/Weyl/Siegel-mass bookkeeping, a seesaw with Bessel periods, a weakening of Vandiver, and use of Behrend.

In this pillar, kernel names contain no occurrence of vandiver, sixfold, relativeTrace, stepanov or bost; they contain seesaw (1,679), bessel (2,946), mass (14,610), chowla (6), poincare (608). Name counts are hints, not evidence of content.
Mathlib Behrend declarations are live in the pillar through Formalism.FrobeniusOrbits.hostThickExists.
VVle/LinkN bound sums of l-adic Sha lengths over all primes and twists below t; reading this as the note's weakened Vandiver statement is our identification, not a Lean name.

Reading cls i as the class set of a lattice genus on a definite unitary group and unf as a theta kernel is our interpretation; ColumnChain itself imposes only cardinality and norm conditions. Where it breaks: the tie predicates linking cls to lattices were not unfolded.
Minkowski (1887): the order of a finite subgroup of GL_n(Q) divides an explicit integer M(n). Green (1955): parametrisation of cuspidal characters of GL_d over a finite field.

Field types in this file are normalised one-line renderings of structure-field contracts (prefix _root_. dropped, the fun arrow printed as ↦, truncated at 170 characters); headers are the first source line of a declaration, cut before := for theorems. No proof text is included.

No finding threatens the hypothesis-free headline theorems: a degenerate intermediate record cannot make a hypothesis-free, kernel-checked conclusion false. The findings bear on how much of the mathematics is readable (Layer 3).

nodes.summary: Pillar root. Three-line term: EveryCharacter from Green (from P.greenRegularCharacters), VWin, and a HypsAlt inhabitant produced by nonempty_hyps_definite_side_of_closed_bound. Inputs P, F, hA, hM, hX, hL, hV are supplied by the caller every_character_of_literature_of_vWin.

Producer of Nonempty (HypsAlt S0.NL DefiniteSideCondition). Proof skeleton of 24 lines read: theta contracts hA/hM enter at three lemma applications (RowRat, ConstantFunctionFits, evaluation grid), volume contract hX at one (L3 row); final step is StageU.hypotheses_nonempty_of_unramified_exponents_alt.
Consumer of HypsAlt: Green + VWin + Nonempty HypsAlt gives EveryCharacter, by imprimitive applied to zero_free_all_of_green_v_win.

Green + VWin + Nonempty HypsAlt gives ZeroFreeAll: eliminates the Nonempty, obtains TopG from the shape theorem with the two bare slots set to True, obtains HostExW (3/2) from supplyChi, applies zeroFreeAll_of_topG.
ZeroFreeAll implies EveryCharacter: reduction from an arbitrary Dirichlet character to its primitive character via Mathlib LFunction_changeLevel; removed Euler factors are nonzero for Re s > 1/2.
For every N, Dirichlet character chi mod N and complex s with Re s > 1/2 and (chi ≠ 1 or s ≠ 1): LFunction chi s ≠ 0. Mathlib ground types only.

nodes.header: def MinkDiv : Prop := ∀ n : ℕ, MinkMult n (minkM n)
nodes.summary: For every n, the order of every finite subgroup of GL_n(Q) divides minkM n (Minkowski 1887).
Proof of MinkDiv used to discharge the guard of hEx (statement read, proof not).
Turns hEx (guarded by MinkDiv) plus selection, duties, two Closed facts and LitThin into existence of designed families; the place where hEx is applied to minkowski_bound_rat.
For every eps in (0, 1/52): constants and a window set of scales such that at every scale in it there exist ranks, a host and q0 with HostGood and the requirement P. HostGood conjuncts not unfolded.

For every primitive psi: VWinAt psi 401 implies HostExW (3/2) (GChi psi).req. Where pillar C output is spent.
VWinAt plus an admissibility statement for frames gives HostExW with requirement (EAtH and VVle).

nodes.summary: For a number field E, bound t and B: all Sha lengths for twists 0 < e < t are finite and the log-weighted sum over any finite set of primes is at most B. Sha/LData not unfolded.
For prime g and d > 0: an injective parametrisation of all cuspidal characters of Gn g d by prime labels, with degree prod_{i=1}^{d-1}(g^i - 1). Shape of Green 1955 for prime fields.
Published.GreenRegularCharacters implies Green.
